t: The Yale 1 star BS night latch provides robust security for external timber doors. This polished chrome night latch features a 60mm backset and is supplied with a TS007 1 star 6-pin rim cylinder, offering advanced protection against common attack methods. It includes anti-drill, anti-pick, anti-bump, and anti-carding features, ensuring enhanced door security. Ideal for residential properties or light commercial applications requiring a high-security locking solution, it incorporates automatic deadlocking and an internal lockable handle for increased safety. The 20mm bolt provides solid engagement, and the unit is supplied with all the necessary fixings for straightforward installation.
